answer_2.quote: We propose CIGEVAL, an autonomous LMM-based agent framework for evaluating conditional image generation.

answer_3.quote: CIGEVAL, our agentic evaluation framework, highlights the glasses object in both images, and finds their different shapes and designs, thereby reaching the correct score.

answer_4.quote: Each image was assessed by three human raters according to the guidelines of the defined task, and a final score in the range [0.0, 1.0] was reported for the average score.
answer_4.guideline: Images are scored in two aspects: (1) Semantic Consistency assesses how well the generated image aligns with the given conditions... (2) Perceptual Quality evaluates the extent to which the generated image appears visually authentic and conveys a sense of naturalness.
